ex.s: Kevin Balke, a research engineer at the Texas A&M University Transportation Institute, says that while smart lights can be particularly beneficial for some cities, others are so jammed that only a sharp reduction in the number of cars on the road will make a meaningful difference.

ex.s: In the past, there was often an automatic reaction to increased traffic: just widen the roads, says Mark Poch, the Bellevue Transportation Department’s traffic engineering manager.

ex.t: 过去，音响工程师在录音棚的后室工作，但如今许多声音专业人士正与其他领域的专业人士分享知识和经验，以基于我们所谓的声音现象创造新产品。

ex.t: 祖父：我只是想让你过得开心，当一名工程师——一个快乐的工程师。

ex.s: Though he acknowledges that engineering works can fail because the person who thought them up or engineered them simply got things wrong, in this book Dr Petroski widens his view to consider the larger context in which such failures occur.
ex.t: 尽管他承认，工程作品之所以会失败，可能是因为构想或设计它们的人犯了简单的错误，但在本书中，彼得罗斯基博士拓宽了视野，去考量此类失败发生的更大背景。

ex.s: There almost are no grades, other than‘Are you working towards your goal?’ Basically, it’s ‘I’ve got to produce this product and then, at the end of year, present it to NASA.’ Engineers come and really do an in-person review, and…it’s not a very nice thing at time.

a person whose job is driving a railway/railroad engine 火车司机；机车司机
a soldier trained to design and build military structures 工兵
to arrange for sth to happen or take place, especially when this is done secretly in order to give yourself an advantage 密谋策划

ex.s: These include plants that have sensors printed onto their leaves to show when they’re short of water and a plant that can detect harmful chemicals in groundwater. ＂We’re thinking about how we can engineer plants to replace functions of the things that we use every day,＂explained Michael Strano, a professor of chemical engineering at MIT.
ex.t: 这些包括叶子上印有传感器、能显示植物何时缺水的植物，以及一种能检测地下水中有害化学物质的植物。“我们正在思考如何改造植物，以取代我们日常使用物品的功能，”麻省理工学院化学工程教授Michael Strano解释道。
